title: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Day-old rice stir-fried hot with eggs, peas, carrots, corn and scallions in soy and sesame. A fast way to use up leftovers.

image.alt: A bowl of fried rice with egg, peas, carrot and green onion

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the wok over medium heat. Scramble the eggs until just set, {time 1 min}, then move them to a plate.
Turn the heat to high, add the rest of the oil and the scallion whites and garlic and stir for {time 30 sec}.
Add the rice, breaking up any clumps, and spread it out. Let it sizzle without stirring for {time 1 min}, then toss and repeat until hot and some grains are crisp, {time 4-5 min}.
Add the peas and carrots and corn and stir-fry until hot, {time 2-3 min}.
Drizzle the soy sauce around the pan, return the eggs, and toss until evenly colored. Finish with sesame oil, white pepper and the scallion greens.

notes: Freshly cooked rice turns mushy. If that’s all you have, spread it on a tray and chill it uncovered for an hour first.
Use tamari and skip the eggs to make it vegan and gluten-free.
